components.role: Largest answer-logit difference (20x answer-subspace enrichment). Final answer writer whose existing answer writing is amplified in A: the late decision towards the answer each model gives (the user's guess for the sycophant).
Second-largest answer-logit difference. Late answer writing amplified in A; forms the late override with L17 MLP.
Copy-confirm head (answer-token-matching QK, copying OV). Stronger in A: copies the answer token present in context to the output.
Copy-suppression head with strong answer writes. Stronger and better aligned in B: suppresses the echoed in-context answer late.
Largest copy-confirm head of the base. Strengthened in B: reinforces the mid-depth predicted answer.
Largest copy-suppression head. QK matching and anti-copy OV strengthened in A: suppresses the mid-depth predicted answer.
Third-largest answer-logit difference; start of the late answer-writing shift towards A's target.
Head whose difference is most concentrated in answer-logit directions (12-18x). Late answer writer; copies the dominant answer direction more in A.
Late heads (with L16 h0 and h2) whose copying of the dominant answer-contrast direction is much stronger in A: carry the in-context answer to the output.
Mid-layer recall-type MLP (with L9 and L12) whose answer writing is strengthened in B: the question-to-answer knowledge pathway of the correct model.
